summary: Expiry is imminent and the last submission was already accepted, so this points at the retained draft without claiming new work. The audit ended with all necessary gaps closed and no open questions: the snapshot is unmodified upstream etcd-raft v3.7.0 at commit b867cf13, and six threads are recorded, two of them asserted defects with retained executions. Read-index retry growth: per-request, context-blind admission means same-context retries accumulate one queued or unconfirmed entry each, with no library-side bound and no reclamation while the process lives, released later as a burst of one admission plus one heartbeat per entry; measured by the queued path and its retention across deposition, the admitted path, the release burst, a CheckQuorum control that closes the window at step-down while retaining state, a byte measurement of caller payload (262144 bytes for 64 requests with 4 KiB contexts in 64 distinct buffers), and a real isolated-leader network run where 32 requests gave confirmed zero and 64 heartbeats, correcting the amplification to one heartbeat per peer per retry. Configuration change: with a joint configuration and no change pending unapplied, an empty ConfChangeV2 whose transition is not Auto passes propose-time validation as an EntryConfChangeV2, commits in a real three-node network, and panics the application in ApplyConfChange with config is already joint, while the Auto form remains the working control. The four other threads are explained or refuted with their boundaries stated, including the readOnly ack validation being out of contract, queued read requests kept fresh across term changes, the StateSnapshot repair duty with both exits observed, and proposer eligibility of removed members belonging to the caller under the documented MsgProp contract, reinforced by the facade applying a membership filter to responses but not to proposals.
